description: Propose edits to EXISTING tasks (move dates, change duration, set progress/status, add or remove links, add a task). Nothing changes until a person approves the proposal. Describe the change in `request`; optionally give exact `edits`.

days.description: shift: workdays (+later/−earlier); set_duration: workdays; link: lag

otherTaskId.description: For link/unlink: the predecessor task id or name

projectId.description: Project id or name. null = the current project.

request.description: The change in plain English, e.g. 'push drywall 3 days for the late inspection'

name: propose_schedule_changes
title: Propose schedule changes
